screen_front_clearance_basis: Renderer diagnostic separation from opaque bezel underlay, not an official physical glass thickness. Screen and selfie punch shifted together; UV/XY/body parameters unchanged.
screen_boundary_basis: Estimated from raw official raster scanlines, not nominal diagonal alone. Inner screen conservative due mild perspective/hand occlusion. Blackmask distinct from exposed metal front frame.
bezel_black_border_basis: Estimated ~2 native raster pixels / 192px body *83.6mm ≈0.87mm; use0.85mm uniform world-space offset, not official CAD.
hinge_profile_basis: Original shallow curved solid profile within unchanged official body bbox, guided by soft metal edge reference; exact cross section estimated, not factory CAD. Replaces prior constant-normal slab.
